problems: In e_ground(), the generic phase(tile,x,y,w,h) call also world-wraps the non-generic gate-approach and gate-threshold crops. The retained Part D gate-interior drawing is 96x144 and has 4px stone kerbs at source columns 0-3 and 92-95. Its road rectangle starts at x=984, so x % 96 = 24. This shifts the complete kerbed drawing sideways: source columns 92-95 and 0-3 become one 8px stone stripe at scene x=1052-1059, inside the 96px route instead of along its edges.

The defect is visible at native 1x through the gateway and along its approach, especially y=432-575. The stripe cuts across the otherwise open slate paving and terminates abruptly at y=576. The expected outer kerbs at x=984-987 and x=1076-1079 are displaced; the threshold is horizontally misregistered as well. This is a visible composition seam/stray road strip, not an intended median or a failure of street-main.png. The retained Part D render shows the same crop with its kerbs correctly on the outside.

Evidence: critic-r17E-3-gate-registration-1x.png compares the same native crop from Part D and Part E. critic-r17E-3-gate-context-E-4x.png and critic-r17E-3-gate-context-D-4x.png show the displaced and correct kerbs; critic-r17E-3-market-detail-3-3x.png shows the approach in context. Pixel checks at y=500 confirm that all eight columns x=1052-1059 are exactly the wrapped source kerb pixels.
